Description:
  Demeanor for .NET v6 - Code Obfuscator

Usage:
  demeanor <assembly> [command] [options]

Arguments:
  <assembly>  Path to the .NET assembly to obfuscate.

Options:
  --out <out>                          Output directory for the obfuscated assembly.
  --include-publics                    Also obfuscate public/protected symbols. Without this flag, publicly visible types and members in library DLLs are preserved. Use for executables that are not referenced by other assemblies.
  --include-deps                       Also obfuscate co-located private dependency assemblies (transitive closure). System and third-party assemblies are loaded for reference only.
  --names <names>                      Name generation mode: Alpha (a,b,c) or Unicode (Canadian Aboriginal Syllabics - most systems lack the font). [default: Alpha]
  --prefix <prefix>                    Namespace prefix for obfuscated top-level types.
  --no-aggressive                      Disable aggressive renaming. By default (Enterprise), all renamed members share the same obfuscated name and property/event metadata is stripped.
  --no-strings                         Disable string encryption.
  --no-constants                       Disable integer constant encryption.
  --no-resources                       Disable encryption of embedded resources.
  --no-virtual-rename                  Disable MethodImpl-based virtual override renaming (Enterprise). When enabled, overrides of external methods like ToString and interface implementations are renamed.
  --no-enum-deletion                   Disable deletion of enum member fields (Enterprise). When enabled, all static literal fields on renamed enums are removed.
  --no-anti-debug                      Disable anti-debug detection (Enterprise). When enabled, debugger detection checks are scattered across method entry points.
  --no-anti-tamper                     Disable anti-tamper integrity verification (Enterprise). When enabled, a module initializer verifies the assembly file has not been modified post-build.
  --no-call-hiding                     Disable call hiding (delegate-backed relay methods that hide call targets from static analysis).
  --proxy-threshold <proxy-threshold>  Minimum IL body size (bytes) for same-assembly methods to be proxied. Default/minimum: 16. [default: 16]
  --cfg <cfg>                          Control flow obfuscation level: Reorder (light), Predicates (medium), Flatten (maximum, default). [default: Flatten]
  --no-cfg                             Disable control flow obfuscation entirely.
  --no-baml                            Disable WPF BAML patching. When set, compiled XAML resources are left unmodified and all types/properties referenced in BAML are frozen from renaming instead.
  --no-hinder-reflection               Disable reflection hindrance. When enabled (default at Enterprise): injects metadata constructs that hinder reflection-based tools and prevents ILDASM disassembly.
  --keyfile <keyfile>                  Strong name key file (.snk) for re-signing.
  --keycontainer <keycontainer>        Strong name key container for re-signing.
  --no-rename                          Disable renaming entirely (types, methods, fields, properties, events, parameters). A member-level [Obfuscation(Feature="rename", Exclude=false)] or [Obfuscation(Feature="rename-propagate", Exclude=false)] opts the marked symbol back in.
  --no-types                           Disable obfuscation of all type names.
  --no-methods                         Disable obfuscation of all method names.
  --no-fields                          Disable obfuscation of all field names.
  --no-properties                      Disable obfuscation of all property names. The PropertyUsageAnalyzer heuristic automatically protects data-bound and serialized properties.
  --no-events                          Disable obfuscation of all event names.
  --no-parameters                      Disable obfuscation of parameter names.
  --no-enumerations, --no-enums        Disable obfuscation of enumeration types.
  --no-resource-names                  Disable obfuscation of managed resource names.
  --no-serial, --no-serializable       Exclude serializable types and their serializable fields.
  --exclude <exclude>                  Exclude a type or member by fully-qualified name (repeatable).
  --xr <xr>                            Exclude types/members matching a regex pattern (repeatable).
  --xa <xa>                            Exclude an assembly from obfuscation by name (repeatable).
  --add-assembly <add-assembly>        Include a dynamically referenced assembly (repeatable).
  --sa, --satellite-assemblies         Update resource names in satellite assemblies.
  --sa-cultures <sa-cultures>          Specific cultures for satellite assembly processing (repeatable).
  --prior-report <prior-report>        Prior version's JSON report for incremental obfuscation (preserves name mappings).
  --report                             Generate a JSON report mapping original to obfuscated names.
  --report-file <report-file>          Path for the JSON report file.
  --verbose                            Display verbose obfuscation statistics.
  --quiet                              Suppress all non-error output.
  --debug                              Preserve debug data (PDB) in the output assembly.
  --no-logo                            Suppress the startup banner.
  --license <license>                  Base64-encoded license key. Also reads from DEMEANOR_LICENSE environment variable.
  --version                            Show version information
  -?, -h, --help                       Show help and usage information


Commands:
  license <key>                   Decode and display license key information.
  audit <assembly>                Pre-obfuscation risk analysis - detect framework patterns that break after obfuscation.
  report <file>                   View an obfuscation report in human-readable format.
  deobfuscate <file>              Map obfuscated names in a crash stack trace back to originals.
  check <assembly>                Detect whether an assembly has already been obfuscated by Demeanor.
  validate-exclusions <assembly>  Test exclusion rules against real metadata without obfuscating.
  init <assembly>                 Wire automatic Release-build obfuscation into a .csproj in the current directory.
